# Convention examples

The example documents of the Zarr conventions, copied unchanged from their
repositories (Apache License 2.0) and prefixed with the convention's name:

| Prefix | Repository | Commit |
|---|---|---|
| `multiscales-` | https://github.com/zarr-conventions/multiscales | `9b78efa75fef0fed302d9cf880037c569354d860` (v0.1) |
| `proj-` | https://github.com/zarr-conventions/proj | `5ca5b2f92e5c7245f957d9128b289ee535f0720d` (v0.1) |
| `spatial-` | https://github.com/zarr-conventions/spatial | `54d81b7ced0376e63ee10f34db31db7d08dcc28d` (v0.1) |

`TestConventionDocuments` validates each of them, and mutations of them,
with Go and with zarr-cm.
